QA Automation Engineer, UrbanPantry — Mar 2024 - Present
Built and maintained Selenium-based test suites to validate web ordering flows, checkout, and promotions, reducing production regressions by ~35%. Implemented TestNG test organization and parallel execution to cut regression time from 6 hours to under 90 minutes. Integrated pipelines with Jenkins for nightly and on-demand runs, producing HTML test reports and automated failure alerts. Worked in Agile sprints, collaborated via Git, and ran test agents on Linux instances.

SDET, Medisure — Nov 2022 - Feb 2024
Designed and executed Automation Testing strategy for core patient portal features using Selenium and TestNG, improving release confidence and lowering post-release defects by 28%. Developed Jenkins pipelines to automate end-to-end test runs and post-build reporting. Wrote Python 3 helper scripts to generate test data and parse test results. Participated in Agile ceremonies and managed test artifacts in Git on Linux workstations.

Founding Engineer, Quanta Retail — Dec 2018 - Oct 2022
Led development of prototype recommendation and search features using Python 3 and emerging LLMs to generate product descriptions and personalized suggestions. Built evaluation harnesses to measure model relevance and A/B test landing page variants, improving click-through on recommended items by 12-18%. Collaborated in small cross-functional teams, maintained code in Git, and deployed inference jobs on Linux servers.
